register.title: Register student

kindHint.student: Student account; you place them in a class group and start the plan later.
kindHint.trial: Access only to the lessons page, until they sign up for a plan.
kindHint.existing: Already has lessons with me: joins the class group directly, with no trial and no prorated charge.

register.name: Full name
register.noGroups: Create a class group before registering a current student.
register.dueDayHint: The first monthly fee is due on the next chosen day.
register.emailHint: They get an e-mail to create a password (the link is valid for 24 hours) and accept the term on first access.

profile.registered: Student registered! We sent the e-mail to create the password.
profile.name: Full name
profile.privateNotesHint: Staff only. The student never sees these notes.
profile.dueDayNotSet: Due day not set yet (the plan hasn't started).
profile.contactHint: Record each attempt to bring the student back. On WhatsApp, the message is ready to send.
profile.retentionDue: This account reached the inactivity period. Decide: keep or remove.
profile.retentionAt: If it stays inactive, you will decide about this account on {date}.
profile.keep: Keep the account (new notice in 6 months)
profile.removeHint: Deletes the student's personal data, profile, notifications and credits. Lesson and billing numbers stay, without personal data. This cannot be undone.
profile.removeConfirm: I understand the data will be deleted and this cannot be undone.

self.title: My profile
self.name: Full name
self.dueDayCurrent: Your monthly fees are due on day {day}.
self.dueDayFrom: You can change the day again from {date}.
self.privacy: Want to delete your account? Talk to the teacher: the administrator confirms and the data is removed.

messages.reengagement: Hi, {name}! 👋 I've missed you here. Shall we get back to your English lessons? Tell me how you're doing!
